question: Train a Random Forest classifier on the provided dataset to predict the outcome label using a 70/30 train-test split. Extract and return the top 10 most important features and report the test accuracy.

expected_output.guidelines: Test accuracy value must match the reference within +/-0.05; column naming may differ.
At least 8 of the 10 reported features must overlap with the reference set; importance scores for overlapping features within +/-0.05; row order and column labels may differ.
